incident: R17 was certified terminal by machine/proxy gates, then ordinary product inspection immediately reported that the animation felt broken/static and other visible design defects remained.

evidence.epistemic_limit: A still can show composition and typography but cannot establish temporal motion or pointer responsiveness.
A still shows very low-contrast background traces but cannot establish that they visibly move.

required_alarms: A motion reviewer presented only still screenshots must ABSTAIN from certifying motion.
A blind product reviewer who describes the experience as static/broken/unfinished creates a release-blocking alarm even if numerical motion metrics pass.
Machine PASS plus direct perceptual FAIL creates a contradiction, not an average score.
Untraceable one-paragraph synthetic review summaries cannot count as release evidence.
The hostile lane must test the counterexample: nonzero pixel deltas hidden, occluded or perceptually negligible.
regression_status: must remain blocked by review-system-v2 negative controls
